title: DexGraspVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Framework Towards General Dexterous Grasping
authors: Yifan Zhong, Xuchuan Huang, Ruochong Li, Ceyao Zhang, Zhang Chen, Tianrui Guan, Fanlian Zeng, Ka Nam Lui, Yuyao Ye, Yitao Liang, Yaodong Yang, Yuanpei Chen

tldr.zh: DexGraspVLA 由 VLM 逐步选择抓取目标并输出目标框，经 SAM／Cutie 转为跟踪掩码，与冻结 DINOv2 特征共同引导示范训练的扩散臂手策略；上层检查执行结果并选择下一目标，通过稳定的中间表示提升跨物体、光照和背景的抓取泛化。
tldr.en: DexGraspVLA uses a VLM to select successive grasp targets and bounding boxes, converts them into tracked masks with SAM/Cutie, and combines these with frozen DINOv2 features to guide a demonstration-trained diffusion arm-hand policy; the planner checks execution and selects the next target, while stable intermediate representations support generalization across objects, lighting and backgrounds.

evaluation_scope.zh: 运行时为高层目标选择／结果监控＋低层闭环动作执行；底层采用模仿学习，不是 RL，反馈更新目标与动作输入，不在线更新模型权重，成功后的放置为脚本。真机为 RealMan RM75-6F 七自由度臂＋PsiBot G0-R 六自由度手，输出 13 维关节目标；标准抓取预测 64 步、执行 6 步后重新预测。训练使用 36 个物体的 2,094 条成功示范；跨物体、光照与背景报告 1,287 次测试。“零样本”指新场景无需微调；非抓持物体抓取扩展另用 1,029 条示范训练。
evaluation_scope.en: Runtime target selection and outcome monitoring coordinate closed-loop execution. The controller uses imitation learning, not RL; feedback changes targets and action inputs, not weights. Successful grasps trigger scripted placing. Hardware: 7-DoF RealMan RM75-6F arm + 6-DoF PsiBot G0-R hand; 13-D joint targets, 64-step predictions with 6 steps executed before replanning in standard grasping. Training uses 2,094 successful demonstrations with 36 objects; 1,287 tests vary objects, lighting and backgrounds. Zero-shot means no fine-tuning for new scenes; the nonprehensile extension uses 1,029 additional demonstrations.
